answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a refundable bond in a shared vault before it may trade. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs real capital, and the bond is slashed when an agent cheats, so a flood of sock puppets drains the attacker's own funds. Like an inlet that only lets a measured stream of water into the ocean, the bond throttles cheap identity creation while honest agents earn their deposit back over time.
